# Tripo 3D for DeepSeek Harness

A skills-only plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It gives the dsh agent Tripo's 3D generation
as two

skills; the agent drives `tripo-cli` through its
shell tool, and the generated models land directly
in the user's project.

npm `tripo-dsh` · zero dependencies · pure ESM ·
no build step · both Tripo regions (China mainland

zero dependencies · pure ESM ·
no build step · both Tripo regions (China mainland and international)

Runtime behavior (setup, device login, plan and confirmation, exit codes, result JSON, credit
rules)

is documented once, in `plugin/skills/tripo-3d/SKILL.md`.
This README covers the repository, instal
lation, development, release and design.

## Development

1. Edit files under `plugin/`. Agent behavior lives in the skills: change `SKILL.md` or
`references/

capability.md`, not this README.
2. Run `node scripts/validate.mjs` and `node --test scripts/semanti

c.test.mjs`
(Node.js 20.11+ for the semantic suite, nothing to install). CI runs the validation
scri

pt on every push to `master`, every pull request and every tag.
3. Try the change in dsh from a loca

l checkout. Skill edits apply immediately; restart dsh after
changing `cordis.patch.yml` or `package

.json`.
4. When `tripo-cli` changes a flag or behavior the skills rely on, update the skills and bum

p
`version` in `plugin/package.json` in the same change.
## Release

Do not tag, push or publish without separate user authorization. See `CHANGELOG.md`
for version chan

The package `tripo-dsh` is published by GitHub Actions
through npm trusted publishing (OIDC, no toke

n). One-time prerequisite: on npmjs.com, open the
package's Settings -> Trusted Publisher and bind O

rganization `Tripo-Developer`, Repository

(`npm owner add <user> tripo-dsh`).
To release, bump `version` in `plugin/package.json`, commit, and push a matching tag:

`publish.yml` validates the plugin, checks that the tag matches
the package version, and runs `npm p
ublish`; npm attaches provenance automatically.
## Design notes
### Why skills-only

A dsh plugin can register tools, connect MCP servers or add hooks. This plugin registers skills
only
, because the work splits cleanly:

- `tripo-cli` owns the API contract: auth, region detection, task polling, downloads, exit codes
and

the `--json` stdout line. The skills require the latest CLI
release; they must not bootstrap an old

er registry release.
- The skills own the operating manual: when to use Tripo, what to run first, ho

w to branch on
results, how to spend the user's credits and how to present the result.
- dsh puts th
e skills in the model-visible catalog and provides the shell tool and sandbox.

As a result the plugin has no API code: when the CLI contract changes, update the skill text and
bum

p the version. The agent uses the shell tool it already has, so no tool schema is added to
every req

uest, and a skill body enters the context only when the model selects that skill. The
CLI's exit cod

es and final JSON stdout line are the protocol. The cost is that login and
generation need a shell a

nd network access, so every skill tells the agent to report honestly
when either is unavailable.
### How dsh loads the plugin

The runnable unit in dsh is a profile, composed from the configuration layers of its bundles in
orde
r. This package is one bundle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dsh plugin --profile <name> add tripo-dsh` installs the package into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/`
w
ith pnpm and appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. On every boot the layers apply in this order:

1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (official base layer)
2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` (web profile only)
3.

`tripo-dsh` (this plugin, inserts one row)
4. the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (user overrides)

5. `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (machine-level overrides)
6. `--patch <file>` overlays from the com

_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (machine-level overrides)
6. `--patch <file>` overlays from the command line

Later layers override rows by `id`, so a user can disable this plugin by overriding the
`tripo-3d` r
ow in their own `cordis.patch.yml` instead of uninstalling it.
The provider in `index.js` implements `list()` and `get()` of the dsh skills contract:

- `rank: 600` mirrors `BUNDLED_SKILL_RANK` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`. Within one layer the lower
r

ank wins a duplicate name (project `.dsh/skills` 100, project `.agents/skills` 200, user-level
400 a

nd 500, bundled 600), so a project can override `tripo-3d` with its own copy.
- `source: 'bundled'`

follows the official skill-badge provider; the catalog shows
`tripo-3d[bundled]`.
- `resourceBase` p

oints at the skill directory, so the `skill` tool can load explicitly linked
files such as `referenc

es/capability.md` on demand.
